title.zh: 一个钱包将155万美元FetchAI盗窃与4.085亿NTX巨额铸造联系起来
title.en: One wallet links $1.55 million FetchAI theft to massive 408.5 million NTX mint

current_state.zh: 根据Athena准备的链上取证报告，攻击者从SingularityNET的以太坊桥中抽走870万枚FET（当时约值155万美元），29分钟后，一个被盗的NuNet minter密钥铸造了4.085亿枚NTX并将其发送至同一接收钱包。报告称，受损的桥授权者和NuNet minter凭证在初始追踪窗口内尚未轮换。
current_state.en: Attackers drained 8.7 million FET, worth about $1.55 million at the time, from SingularityNET’s Ethereum bridge, and 29 minutes later a compromised NuNet minter created 408.5 million NTX sent to the same receiving wallet, according to an on-chain forensic report prepared by Athena. The report said the compromised bridge authorizer and NuNet minter credentials had not yet been rotated during the initial tracking window.
